notes: No model in examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/ or model code reads this class (repo-wide grep; only earth2studio/data, lexicon, CHANGELOG and docs/modules/datasources_analysis.md mention it), so winning_model is null and variables are the source lexicon. Full WB2ClimatetologyLexicon.VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/wb2.py:98-120), 105 variables, all present in the default store (checked by listing the zarr group).
Default store 1990-2017_6h_1440x721.zarr is used (wb2.py:510; the docstring says 1990-2019 but the code default is 1990-2017). Other stores are selectable with climatology_zarr_store.

Any 6-hourly time is valid; only hour-of-day and day-of-year are used (wb2.py:641-672). recipes/eval mentions a climatology DataSource for ACC (recipes/eval/README.md:803) but does not name WB2Climatology.
